maddeler.e:
ابتغوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَغَوْا (ibtaḡaw) /ib.ta.ɣaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اُبْتُغُوا (ubtuḡū) /ub.tu.ɣuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اِبْتَغُوا (ibtaḡū) /ib.ta.ɣuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
